name: Hoagie Buns

steps.title: Prepare Preferment
steps.description: Mix 85g of the bread flour, 50g water, 2g sugar, 2g oil, 2g salt, and 1g yeast on medium speed to full gluten development. Ferment in an airtight container for 12 hours in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Mix Final Dough
steps.description: Combine remaining flour, water, sugar, oil, salt, yeast, malt syrup, and pâte fermentée with the preferment. Mix on medium speed until full gluten development.

steps.title: Bulk Fermentation
steps.description: Ferment dough lightly oiled and covered. No folds.

steps.title: Preshape
steps.description: Preshape each portion into a short bâtard.

steps.title: Final Shape
steps.description: Shape into hoagie-style bâtards and place on parchment-lined sheet pans.

steps.title: Final Proof
steps.description: Proof at 27°C and 65% RH until fully aerated.

steps.title: Score
steps.description: Apply egg wash if desired, then score each bun with a single cut down the center.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake in a convection oven at 190°C (375°F) for 20–25 minutes until golden. Buns should remain soft with a thin crust.

notes: Apply egg wash before scoring if desired. Preferment provides strength and mild acidity. Buns should remain soft with a thin crust. Preferment uses 85g of the total 620g bread flour.
